migration_roadmap.replacement: Replace RSA with ML-KEM-1024 (FIPS 203) for key exchange, ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) for signatures
Replace ECDH with ML-KEM-768 + X25519 hybrid
Replace ECDSA with ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) or SPHINCS+ (FIPS 205)
Replace MD5 with SHA-256 or SHA-3-256
Ensure using PQC algorithm (ML-KEM) with EVP_PKEY API
Ensure using TLS 1.3 with PQC cipher suites
Ensure using EVP_aes_256_gcm() for authenticated encryption
